_readme: Sample schedule for the Visitor Welcome Display. The page shows the visit whose [startsAt, expiresAt] window contains the current time; if none is active it shows the Burkes standby slide. Times are ISO-8601 UTC (with Z). Power Automate overwrites this file to queue visits. Unknown keys (like this one) are ignored by the page. See Visitor-Welcome-Display-BRIEF.md.
